# Soup
> The right logs. Not the whole log. Soup selects the log lines an AI coding agent needs — crash evidence, query matches, and why they stayed. Local, inspectable, budgeted. Free MIT open source.

Local CLI and MCP prune need no API key and do not upload logs. Prefer these markdown files over HTML.

## Docs
- [Homepage](https://trysoup.dev/index.md): Product overview, install, MCP
- [Welcome](https://trysoup.dev/docs/index.md): What Soup is and how to start
- [Install CLI](https://trysoup.dev/docs/install.md): One-line installer, PATH, manual binaries
- [CLI usage](https://trysoup.dev/docs/cli.md): Flags, stdin/file, query and budget
- [Connect an agent](https://trysoup.dev/docs/mcp.md): roka-mcp for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline
- [MCP tools](https://trysoup.dev/docs/tools.md): prune_logs, prune_file, prune_tail
- [Watch mode](https://trysoup.dev/docs/watch.md): Tail a log and write crash context
- [How pruning works](https://trysoup.dev/docs/pipeline.md): Collapse, rank (query / crash / neighbor / recency), pack
- [Pricing](https://trysoup.dev/pricing.md): Free and open source
- [Benchmark](https://trysoup.dev/docs/benchmark.md): LogHub MVP numbers and limits
- [FAQ](https://trysoup.dev/docs/faq.md): Offline use, RAG vs prune, data handling
- [MCP server](https://trysoup.dev/.well-known/mcp-server): Discovery manifest for roka-mcp

## Optional
